name: Homm Laguna Bintan
short_description: A Homm-branded island getaway in Lagoi with rainforest and beach access, a spa, fitness centre, and outdoor pool.
ai_summary: Homm Laguna Bintan is a resort property in Lagoi positioned as an island getaway, with rainforest trekking, beach strolls, and sunset views from guest balconies. Facilities include a spa and wellness centre, a well-equipped fitness centre, and an outdoor swimming pool. It sits within Bintan's broader Laguna resort area alongside Banyan Tree Bintan and Cassia Bintan. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
